name: Arugal's Folly
summary: Worgen hold Deep Elem Mine in Silverpine's southeastern hills, keeping the Forsaken from ore needed by Varimathras's forces. Dalar Dawnweaver sends you to slay their corrupted foreman, Grimson the Pale, and carry his head to the Sepulcher.

sections.title: Securing the Depths
sections.body: Dalar Dawnweaver learns from the Forsaken Darkstalkers that worgen have reached Deep Elem Mine in Silverpine's southeastern hills. Their feral sorcery spread from Shadowfang Keep, where Archmage Arugal unleashed dark enchantments across the forest. Ore from the mine is needed to arm the Undercity. But worgen now make their lair in its shafts, and the mine lies unusable.

sections.title: The Severed Head
sections.body: Grimson the Pale leads the worgen through the mine's infested shafts. Dalar Dawnweaver orders you to slay the corrupted foreman and bring his head to the Sepulcher. With Grimson gone, the worgen will lose their leader, and Forsaken laborers can claim the mine for Lord Varimathras.

faq.answer: Grimson the Pale is the foreman of Deep Elem Mine. Like many laborers and residents in southern Silverpine, he was corrupted by magic from Archmage Arugal's experiments. Now he oversees a den overrun by worgen.

faq.q: Where is the Deep Elem Mine located?
faq.answer: Deep Elem Mine lies in the craggy hills southeast of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Its tunnels run deep into the hillside and teem with worgen.

faq.q: Why does Varimathras care about a mining operation?
faq.answer: Varimathras oversees the strategic expansion of Forsaken power. The mine's high-yield iron and stone are vital to arming troops and reinforcing fortresses throughout Lordaeron.

faq.q: What happens after Grimson is slain?
faq.answer: Dalar Dawnweaver takes Grimson's head as proof of victory. Then he turns his attention to Arugal's spreading influence and prepares to strike at its heart.

faq.q: What kind of magic corrupted the mine?
faq.answer: Archmage Arugal unleashed wild otherworldly magic and worgen curses across Silverpine. That magic reached Deep Elem Mine, corrupting its foreman, Grimson the Pale, and leaving the shafts overrun by worgen.

faq.q: Who are the Darkstalkers mentioned by Dalar Dawnweaver?
faq.answer: The Darkstalkers are the Forsaken military's covert intelligence and scouting branch. From outposts like the Sepulcher, they watch enemy troop movements and regional anomalies.

angles.text: As an undead, you help secure metal for the Forsaken to fortify their young nation against the living and the Scourge.
As a miner, you can seek Deep Elem Mine's rich ore veins once its tainted workers are cleared out.
As a mage, you can see the danger in Arugal's runaway conjurations and transmutations seeping into the mines.
